kindHint.container: Drift when the container is missing, stopped, running another image, or its configuration differs.
kindHint.stack: Drift when a service from the stack's compose file is missing or not running, or the stack runs containers its file does not declare.
kindHint.environment: Drift when a container runs here that no container or stack watch in this environment accounts for. Label a container mcharbor.reconciler.ignore=true to leave it out.

details.title: What drifted: {{name}}
details.none: No drift was found in the last check.

observeOnly: Stack and environment watches cannot be reconciled directly; propose a fix instead.

report.title: Drift report
report.description: Every confirmed drift across all watches, what has been wrong longest first.

gitManagedDelete: Managed by a Git source: delete its document in the repository instead.

mode.title: How to answer drift: {{name}}
mode.description: Choose what McHarbor does when this watch drifts.
mode.label: When it drifts
mode.enforceWarning: Enforce changes containers without asking anyone. It only acts while enforcement is switched on in the reconciler settings, within its per-pass limit and cooldown, and stops on repeated failures until someone resets it.

hint.observe: Record the drift, alert on it, and change nothing.
hint.propose: Also write a plan to restore the desired state for someone to review and approve.
hint.enforce: Apply the plan automatically when every step can be taken without a person; otherwise write a plan to review.

proposals.title: Reconcile plans
proposals.description: Plans to restore desired state, waiting for review, and the record of every plan applied by a person or by enforcement.
proposals.staleNotice: The drift changed since this plan was written, so it was not applied. This is the plan for the drift as it is now; review it again.
proposals.approveWarning: Approving applies these steps to the environment now. McHarbor checks the drift again first and refuses if it changed.

manual.missing: The container does not exist, and a desired state does not hold enough to create it. Deploy it, then check again.
manual.compose_managed: The container belongs to a compose stack; change the stack rather than the container.
manual.ports: Published ports cannot be changed by recreating; edit the container or its stack.
manual.mounts: Mounts cannot be changed by recreating; edit the container or its stack.
manual.networks: Attach the container to its networks from the container or network page.
manual.protected: This is a protected container (McHarbor or its agent) and is never changed automatically.
manual.stack_remove: Removing a stack is never planned; take it down from the stack page.
manual.stack_stop: Stopping a stack is never planned; stop it from the stack page.
manual.git_compose: The stack's compose file comes from Git; deploy it through its GitOps pipeline.

refusal.stale: The drift changed since this plan was written. A fresh plan was written instead.
refusal.unknown: The environment cannot be reached right now, so nothing was changed.
refusal.no_drift: There is no drift to act on.
refusal.cannot_act: This McHarbor node cannot apply changes.
refusal.git_managed: This watch is managed by a Git source. Change it in the repository.
refusal.enforce_route: Enforce is granted from the watch's response setting.
refusal.not_git_managed: This watch is not managed by a Git source.
refusal.not_expressible: None of this drift can be written back to the repository.
refusal.git_failed: Git refused the change. Check the repository's credentials and branch.
refusal.sync_failed: The sync failed; the reason is shown on the source.
refusal.confirm_passes_range: Confirm passes must be between 1 and 10.
refusal.actions_per_pass_range: Actions per pass must be between 1 and 25.
refusal.cooldown_range: The cooldown must be between 0 and 86400 seconds.
refusal.failure_threshold_range: The failure threshold must be between 1 and 20.
refusal.source_fields_required: A name, a repository and an environment are required.
refusal.invalid_branch: That branch name is not valid.
refusal.path_escapes_repo: The path must stay inside the repository.

pullRequest.title: Accept drift in Git: {{name}}
pullRequest.description: McHarbor rewrites this watch's document to match what is running, pushes it to a new branch, and opens a pull request for review. Nothing changes until someone merges it.
pullRequest.noRequest: The branch was pushed, but no pull request was opened: {{error}}

sources.title: Git sources
sources.description: Repositories whose documents are desired state. A commit changes intent within one reconciler pass; rows from Git are edited in the repository.
sources.addDescription: Every YAML or JSON document under the path becomes a watch in the current environment.
sources.name: Name
sources.formatHint: A document holds name, kind, containerName, imageRef, stackName, desiredStatus, restartPolicy, mode (observe or propose) and config; a file may list several under desiredStates. Enforce cannot be set from Git.
sources.deleteDescription: Stop reading desired state from {{name}}. Its watches stay, and can then be edited here.

settings.title: Reconciler settings
settings.description: How drift is confirmed, and the limits enforcement works within.
settings.confirmPassesHint: Drift is recorded only after this many consecutive checks see it, so a rolling update is not reported. Raise it on slow hosts.
settings.enforcementHint: Off by default. Only watches set to Enforce are acted on, and only within these limits.
settings.breakerOpen: Enforcement stopped after repeated failures at {{time}}. Nothing is enforced until it is reset.

pick.containerHint: Picking an existing container fills in the image and status it runs now. Enter a name manually to declare one that does not exist yet.

plugin.pinHint: Pin only what should be held. A property left on "Not managed" is never checked.
